name: ghost-windows
description: Local-first MCP memory server for Claude Code on native Windows: one SQLite file, hybrid search, on-demand consolidation. Each archive bundles one native ghost.exe; install the marketplace entry for this PC's architecture (ghost-windows-amd64 for most PCs, ghost-windows-arm64 for Windows on ARM). Without the plugin, install the standalone binary from install.ps1 and run `ghost mcp init`. First-run setup is automatic and persistent: it disables Claude Code's built-in file memory, imports memories from projects GhostMem already knows (others import on first use), and writes MEMORY.md redirects in known projects — these changes remain if you uninstall the plugin. The stop-hook save reminder is on by default; the LLM consolidation passes (`reflect`/`resolve`/`supersede`) are opt-in and off by default.
